shadowSentences: I like to read books every day.
My favorite season is autumn in October.
I enjoy cooking new recipes on weekends.
Traveling to new places gives me joy.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
I often go hiking during the summer holidays.
Spending time with friends brings me happiness.
I find it exciting to learn new languages online.
Gardening is a rewarding hobby that I cherish.
Volunteering in my community has changed my perspective.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What challenges did you face during that trip?
Q3: How do you feel about traveling to new destinations?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy doing?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to keep up with a routine?
Q3: Why do you think exercise is important for health?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone starting an exercise journey?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical daily meals?
Q2: Have you encountered any dietary challenges recently?
Q3: What is your opinion on healthy eating in today's society?
Q4: What suggestions would you make for someone wanting to eat healthier?
